content:
mika: Heads-up — ran a kvcache prefetch patch (prefetch=16) in orion-v3 int8 bringup. Quick smoke shows BLEU drop: zh->en -2.4, ja->en -1.1. Anyone else see tokenization weirdness near ZWJ / fullwidth hyphen?
cheng: I saw similar on a small batch run (batch=8, q5 kernel). Outputs inserting U+200D midword occasionally. I'll paste a tiny repro below. :eyes:
cheng: ```
input: 我喜欢猫  (orig text had ZWJ between 喜 and 猫)
baseline tokens: ["我","喜欢","猫"]
prefetch=16 tokens: ["我","喜","\u200d猫"]
model output baseline: 我喜欢猫
model output prefetch: 我喜\u200d猫
```
samir: can you drop the eval id and sample index?
mika: eval `2024-03-18-kv-prefetch-orf`, sample 42 (attached in the eval set). Also replayed with longctx=12k and saw same pattern.
leah: quick hypothesis — prefetch changes when we materialize kv cache slices, shifting subtoken boundaries used by detokenizer heuristics. Our detok expects contiguous offsets; prefetch inserts a cache boundary and the detok joins differently.
samir: ok let's triage: 1) repro with prefetch=0, 2) prefetch=1,4,8,16 to find threshold, 3) run tokenizer-only golden checks to see offset invariance.
cheng: ran prefetch=0 earlier — BLEU stable. prefetch>=8 shows regressions. re-running prefetch=4 now (ETA ~8m).
eval-bot: run `2024-03-18-kv-prefetch-orf` started (tags: zh-en, ja-en, longctx=12k, seed=47).
ciaran-deploy-bot: canary push `kvcache-prefetch@d3f4a2` -> orion-v3 succeeded (canary=3 nodes).
mika: here's the small runtime diff I'm testing: ```diff
- kvcache.prefetch = 0
+ kvcache.prefetch = 16
  // prefetch window preallocates slices to reduce tail latency
```
leah: potential quick fix — remap tokenizer subtoken start indices after prefetch finalize step, then run detok assertions. I started a draft PR: `fix/kvcache-detok-align` (WIP).
cheng: repro snippet with exact chars: input "我喜欢\u200d猫" (ZWJ U+200D between 喜 and 猫). baseline detok -> "我喜欢猫"; prefetch->"我喜\u200d猫" which downstream model treats differently. This explains BLEU hit on zh->en where phrase boundaries mattered.
samir: can we add a unit in tokenizer tests that inserts ZWJ/fullwidth-hyphen variants and asserts stable detok across kvcache config toggles? If so we can catch this in CI.
mika: created ticket INF-3291 with repro, eval links, and sample logs. Tagging @eng-ml for visibility. Action items: bisect prefetch commit, add tokenizer invariance unit, gate prefetch behind additional detok checks.
leah: I'll follow up with the PR and a short regression test matrix.
cheng: prefetch=4 run finished: BLEU delta zh->en -0.6, ja->en -0.2. seems like threshold between 4 and 8.
samir: good data. canary rolled back to prefetch=1 for now.
mika: thanks all — will update INF-3291 with bisect plan. :thumbsup:
